title: Sieve Estimation of Optimal Transport Maps from Paired Data in Gaussian Spaces
summary: We study the estimation of infinite-dimensional optimal transport maps from noisy paired observations. The population map pushes a Gaussian reference measure forward to a target probability measure on a function space and takes the Cameron--Martin gradient form $T=I+\nabla_{\mathcal H}φ$. Our estimator uses cylindrical gradient sieves based on finitely many Cameron--Martin coordinates, thereby reducing the problem to finite-dimensional empirical risk minimization.
